messages.text:
The cancelled card doesn't matter. A cancelled proposal doesn't count against a new request (refund-policy/v2/window). The bath towel is also still unrefunded, so nothing has been paid on it.

I've created a new proposal for the hand towel only. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund would be 149.99 BRL, which is what you paid for that unit (refund-policy/v2/amount).

To confirm it, press the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't confirm anything. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve the request (refund-policy/v2/approval). The refund is complete only once you have a receipt.
